body.name: \(\mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G),\mathcal A_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
For \(T=(B^{(a)})_{a\in M}\), let \(\mathcal U(T)\) be the directed union-support graph on \(V\), with \(i\to j\) exactly when \(B^{(a)}[j,i]\ne0\) for at least one \(a\in M\), and let \(\operatorname{TC}^{+}(\mathcal U(T))\) be its strict transitive closure.  On nonempty fibers define
\[
 \mathcal A_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \bigcap_{T\in\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)}
 \operatorname{TC}^{+}(\mathcal U(T)),
 \qquad
 \mathcal A_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)=
 \bigcap_{T\in\Theta_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)}
 \operatorname{TC}^{+}(\mathcal U(T)).
\]
The first is published-class common ancestry; the second is the component-aligned common ancestry reported from the pairing-informative stream.
